trajectory_summary: The call opens on confusion and mild hearing/comprehension friction, briefly stabilizes through verify, then collapses when the rep unilaterally disqualifies the home from a satellite image within seconds of reaching the roof question. The customer pushes back three times with specific, reasonable counter-evidence and is never offered a path to an actual assessment — energy leaks out steadily until the rep ends the call. This is a DQ the transcript does not actually support as final; it reads as a premature call-ending judgment, not a resolved hard gate.
